entities.summary: Achaemenid Persian Empire, a political institution in Kazakhstan during Ancient Steppe Cultures (800 BCE–200 BCE). Grew from Evidence of mare's milk consumption — earliest known kumis production and Botai people domesticate horses on the northern Kazakh steppe. Led to the emergence of Saka and Scythian Nomads.
